theme: Nostalgia: a parent and child riding bikes into an autumn tunnel

text.line:
someone rode next to you
until you didn't
need them to.

hooks_considered: someone rode next to you until you didn't need them to.
you won't remember the day they let go of the bike.
the summers felt endless because nobody was counting.

post.caption: Who taught you to ride? 🍂
